method.timeToFirstApple: performance.now() in the page when the game logs its first apple; 0 is navigation start.
method.screensBeforeFirstApple: Segments of the game's screen log between navigation start and the first apple. "(page load)" is the time before the game reports its first screen.
method.bot: tools/rig/bot.mjs. Seed 1. It acts only on screens already drawn, presses the key a screen offers to leave it (skip/continue/restart) at once, and on control screens takes a shortest path to the apple (breadth-first search). Keys are real key presses (Playwright keyboard). It polls the game every 4 ms.
method.controlShare: Time in control screens (ready, play) divided by the session, over the first sessionMs from navigation start. Control screens are those where arrow keys steer the snake; the list is fixed in tools/rig/stats.mjs.
method.steering: In play, every turn key the bot sends is checked on the next look at the game: accepted means the game now heads that way. A turn sent just before the snake died cannot be checked and is counted as unchecked.
method.load: performance.now() of the first drawn frame of a screen that accepts any key: the first frame of a control screen, or the game's first "accepts" log entry (the first drawn frame where another screen starts reacting to a key), whichever comes first.
method.memory: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage().usedSize of the page, read right after CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage, at the moment the bot has had playMsForMemory of control. The value before garbage collection is kept too.
method.origin: Every request of every run must go to the page's own origin (scheme, host and port of the game); any other request is listed in checks.externalRequests and fails the checks (tools/rig/stats.mjs offOrigin).
method.download: Sum of CDP Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength over every request of the session (headers + body; no compression, browser cache disabled).
method.size: Files in dist/<version>/. js = .js and .mjs; code = js + .html + .css; assets = every other file. Lines = newline characters, like wc -l (tools/rig/size.mjs).
method.frameRate: Method 2 (since 2026-10-14, prompt 4): over the first 60 s of play, the same window as the heap. Every requestAnimationFrame timestamp is recorded by a script injected before the game; only frames inside control screens count, taken in order from navigation start until 60000 ms of control (by the game's screen log), and frames within the heap read (+500 ms) are left out. Per run: median = median of per-second frame counts (1-second windows, like an FPS counter); p5 = 5th percentile (nearest rank) of per-frame values, 1000 / interval between two frames. The version's figure is the median over runs. Per-frame values are not used for the median because rAF timestamps snap to the 60 Hz display: a 25 ms frame shows up as 16.7 and 33.3 ms intervals in turn. Method 1 took the control frames of the first 60 s from navigation start; its files are in measurements/old-method/.
method.frameRateWindow: Frame rate is measured in a visible Chromium window, not headless: on this Mac, headless and visible medians agreed on CPU and GPU loads, but the 5th percentile did not (see measurements/fps-check.json). The headless runs' frame rate is kept as headlessFps for comparison.
method.medians: Median over runs: the middle value of 5 (mean of the two middle values for an even count).

size.tool: tools/rig/size.mjs: newline characters per file, like wc -l
